title: Projection Operator Stochastic Equations for Non-Markovian Quantum Systems Under Continuous Measurement-Based Feedback
summary: Quantum Markov models have been successfully used to accurately model various physical quantum systems in fields such as quantum optics, optomechanics and superconducting circuits and they provide the basis for (measurement-based) quantum feedback control. However, the quantum Markov assumption is a strong one and it is not expected to hold for general quantum systems of interest.
